description: This file contains fuzzing functions for the Kubernetes API server's example API group, including overrides for metadata functions and specific fuzzing functions for PodSpec, PodPhase, and RestartPolicy objects.

methods.name: overrideMetaFuncs
methods.description: Overrides some generic fuzzer functions to produce more realistic data in a Kubernetes context.

methods.name: exampleFuncs
methods.description: Provides fuzzing functions for the example API objects such as PodSpec, PodPhase, and RestartPolicy.
